  date_travel: 'Start Date\*\s*(\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{4})'
  booking_reference: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n\s*(\d{10})\b'
  train_number: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n\s*\d{10}\s{2,}(\S.*?)\s{2,}'
  travel_class: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n[^\n]*[ \t]{2,}(\S[^\n]*?)[ \t]*$'

  travel_from: '(?m)^\s+Booked From\s+To\s*\n\s*\n\s*\S.*?\([A-Z]+\)\s{2,}(\S.*?\([A-Z]+\))\s{2,}'
  travel_to: '(?m)^\s+Booked From\s+To\s*\n\s*\n[^\n]*\s{2,}(\S.*?\([A-Z]+\))\s*$'

  passengers: {parser: regex, regex: '(?m)^(\d+)\.[ \t]+\S[^\n]*?[ \t]{2,}\d{1,3}[ \t]+[MFT][ \t][^\n]*\n(?!\d+\.[ \t])', type: int}
  place_of_supply: 'Place of Supply:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s+State Name/Code'

  amount: 'Total Fare \(all inclusive\)\s+([\d,]+\.\d{2})'

    types:
      price_total: float

  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d-%b-%Y']
  replace:
    - ['\r', '']

prompt:
TEMPLATE FORMAT (YAML; use single quotes around every regular expression)
Shapes: fields, options, checks, new_fields and new_line_fields are MAPPINGS (name: value), never
lists; keywords, exclude_keywords, continuation_keywords, required_fields and optional_fields are
LISTS of texts.
issuer: <company that issues the document>
keywords: [2 to 4 texts printed on EVERY document of this layout and on no other issuer's
           documents: the issuer's name, its fixed headings. NEVER a value that changes per
           document (customer name or address, numbers, dates, amounts). Each keyword is copied
           exactly from the text and lies inside one column: never across a gap of 2+ spaces.]
exclude_keywords: [optional: texts that appear only on a look-alike layout]
continuation_keywords: [optional: texts on the following pages that carry no document number
                        (terms pages, annexures); those pages are attached to the document]
required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name, ...]
optional_fields: [fields printed on some documents of this layout only]
fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}     # tax_invoice, credit_note, receipt, ...
  invoice_number: 'Invoice No\.\s*:\s*(\S+)'             # exactly ONE capture group
  date: 'Invoice Date\s*:\s*(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})'
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)Sold By\s*\n(.*?)\nGSTIN', replace: [['\s+', ' ']]}
  tax_rate: {parser: regex, regex: '([\d.]+)%\s+IGST', type: float}
  amount: 'Grand Total\s+(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?)'
  lines:                                                  # the item table
    parser: lines
    start: 'Description\s+Qty\s+Amount'                   # a regex on the header line
    end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                                  # a regex on the line after the table
    first_line: '^\s*(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?P<qty>\d+)\s+(?P<price_total>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s{4,}(?P<name>\S.*?)\s*$'                   # continuation lines of a row (optional)
    skip_line: '^\s*Page \d'                              # optional
    types: {qty: int, price_total: float}
checks:                                                   # optional, see CHECKS
  disable: [qty x unit price]
  line: [{name: ..., rule: "qty * (price_unit - discount_unit) == price_total", tolerance: "0.01"}]
  document: [{name: ..., rule: "amount_untaxed + amount_cgst + amount_sgst == amount"}]
options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d/%m/%Y']                              # REQUIRED when dates are numeric
  replace: [['\r', '']]

TEXT FORM: the text below is what the engine gives every template: pdftotext -layout output,
put in a standard form: "Label :" is written "Label:", trailing spaces removed, shared
indentation removed, at most one blank line in a row. Columns are separated by 2+ spaces.

PATTERN RULES
- Accept small print variations: \s* around colons, \s+ between words, amounts as
  (\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?) so 212.1, 212.10 and 17.582 all match.
- Use (?m) with ^ or $, (?s) when . must cross lines. Never write a pattern that can take a
  value from a different column of the same line: stop at 2+ spaces (\s{2,}) when a right-hand
  column follows.
- Two-column blocks (seller left, buyer right): read each column with patterns that skip the
  other column, or use replace to drop it.
- Only field names from the FIELD LIST below. A field the list lacks may be declared in
  new_fields (document level) or new_line_fields (item table), with type text, date, money,
  rate, count or number; money fields that are part of the total need a role
  (tax, untaxed, total, other).
- amount is the final total payable of the document. Read every printed total you can (taxable
  value, each tax, round off) so the arithmetic checks can prove the values.
- ASCII only in the YAML; write a non-ASCII character as an escape such as '₹'.

CHECKS: by default the engine checks, where the values exist (names in brackets):
  per line: qty * price_unit - discount = line total [qty x unit price]; gross - discount
  [gross - discount]; taxable + taxes = line total [taxable value + tax]; rate * taxable = tax
  [cgst rate], [sgst rate], [igst rate], [cess rate], [line tax rate]
  per document: [line tax vs document tax]; [untaxed + tax + adjustments = total];
  [paid + due = total]; [due = total]; and for every line column the sum of the lines equals the
  document total it adds up to ("sum of line price_total vs amount", ...).
A document is OK only when at least one check with non-zero values passes. Disable a default

EXAMPLE OF A WORKING TEMPLATE (another issuer; for the format only):
# IRCTC - Electronic Reservation Slip (ERS), the e-ticket for an Indian Railways train booking.
# It is a booking confirmation with a payment breakdown, not a GST tax invoice: no GSTIN and no
# tax amounts are printed. The payment breakdown is read as the lines; they add up to the
# all-inclusive total. Passenger names are not read (only how many passengers there are).
issuer: IRCTC (Indian Railways)

keywords:
  - 'Electronic Reservation Slip'
  - 'Train No./Name'
  - 'Total Fare (all inclusive)'
# the instruction pages that follow carry no PNR or transaction number
continuation_keywords:
  - 'www.irctc.co.in'
  - 'TDR'

required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, booking_reference]

fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: e_ticket}
  seller_name: {parser: static, value: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC)}
  invoice_number: 'Transaction ID:\s*(\d+)'
  # booking date and time: "17-Aug-2026 11:04:44 HRS"
  date: '(\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{4})\s+\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\s+HRS'
  date_travel: 'Start Date\*\s*(\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{4})'
  booking_reference: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n\s*(\d{10})\b'
  train_number: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n\s*\d{10}\s{2,}(\S.*?)\s{2,}'
  travel_class: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n[^\n]*[ \t]{2,}(\S[^\n]*?)[ \t]*$'
  # stations row: boarding station, from, to
  boarding_from: '(?m)^\s+Booked From\s+To\s*\n\s*\n\s*(\S.*?\([A-Z]+\))\s{2,}'
  travel_from: '(?m)^\s+Booked From\s+To\s*\n\s*\n\s*\S.*?\([A-Z]+\)\s{2,}(\S.*?\([A-Z]+\))\s{2,}'
  travel_to: '(?m)^\s+Booked From\s+To\s*\n\s*\n[^\n]*\s{2,}(\S.*?\([A-Z]+\))\s*$'
  # the number of the last passenger row (the next line is not a passenger row)
  passengers: {parser: regex, regex: '(?m)^(\d+)\.[ \t]+\S[^\n]*?[ \t]{2,}\d{1,3}[ \t]+[MFT][ \t][^\n]*\n(?!\d+\.[ \t])', type: int}
  place_of_supply: 'Place of Supply:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s+State Name/Code'

  amount: 'Total Fare \(all inclusive\)\s+([\d,]+\.\d{2})'

  lines:
    parser: lines
    start: '(?m)^Payment Details\s*$'
    end: 'Total Fare \(all inclusive\)'
    # "Catering Charges (Incl. of GST)          1,180.00"
    line: '^(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?P<price_total>[\d,]+\.\d{2})\s*$'
    types:
      price_total: float

options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d-%b-%Y']
  replace:
    - ['\r', '']
    - ['\u20b9 *', '']

# IRCTC - Electronic Reservation Slip (ERS), the e-ticket for an Indian Railways train booking.
# It is a booking confirmation with a payment breakdown, not a GST tax invoice: no GSTIN and no
# tax amounts are printed. The payment breakdown is read as the lines; they add up to the
# all-inclusive total. Passenger names are not read (only how many passengers there are).
issuer: IRCTC (Indian Railways)

keywords:
  - 'Electronic Reservation Slip'
  - 'Train No./Name'
  - 'Total Fare (all inclusive)'
# the instruction pages that follow carry no PNR or transaction number
continuation_keywords:
  - 'www.irctc.co.in'
  - 'TDR'

required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, booking_reference]

fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: e_ticket}
  seller_name: {parser: static, value: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC)}
  invoice_number: 'Transaction ID:\s*(\d+)'
  # booking date and time: "17-Aug-2026 11:04:44 HRS"
  date: '(\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{4})\s+\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\s+HRS'
  date_travel: 'Start Date\*\s*(\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{4})'
  booking_reference: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n\s*(\d{10})\b'
  train_number: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n\s*\d{10}\s{2,}(\S.*?)\s{2,}'
  travel_class: '(?m)^\s+PNR\s+Train No\./Name[^\n]*\n[^\n]*[ \t]{2,}(\S[^\n]*?)[ \t]*$'
  # stations row: boarding station, from, to
  boarding_from: '(?m)^\s+Booked From\s+To\s*\n\s*\n\s*(\S.*?\([A-Z]+\))\s{2,}'
  travel_from: '(?m)^\s+Booked From\s+To\s*\n\s*\n\s*\S.*?\([A-Z]+\)\s{2,}(\S.*?\([A-Z]+\))\s{2,}'
  travel_to: '(?m)^\s+Booked From\s+To\s*\n\s*\n[^\n]*\s{2,}(\S.*?\([A-Z]+\))\s*$'
  # the number of the last passenger row (the next line is not a passenger row)
  passengers: {parser: regex, regex: '(?m)^(\d+)\.[ \t]+\S[^\n]*?[ \t]{2,}\d{1,3}[ \t]+[MFT][ \t][^\n]*\n(?!\d+\.[ \t])', type: int}
  place_of_supply: 'Place of Supply:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s+State Name/Code'

  amount: 'Total Fare \(all inclusive\)\s+([\d,]+\.\d{2})'

  lines:
    parser: lines
    start: '(?m)^Payment Details\s*$'
    end: 'Total Fare \(all inclusive\)'
    # "Catering Charges (Incl. of GST)          1,180.00"
    line: '^(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?P<price_total>[\d,]+\.\d{2})\s*$'
    types:
      price_total: float

options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d-%b-%Y']
  replace:
    - ['\r', '']
    - ['\u20b9 *', '']

put in a standard form: "Label :" is written "Label:", trailing spaces removed, shared
indentation removed, at most one blank line in a row. Columns are separated by 2+ spaces.

PATTERN RULES
- Accept small print variations: \s* around colons, \s+ between words, amounts as
  (\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?) so 212.1, 212.10 and 17.582 all match.
- Use (?m) with ^ or $, (?s) when . must cross lines. Never write a pattern that can take a
  value from a different column of the same line: stop at 2+ spaces (\s{2,}) when a right-hand
  column follows.
- Two-column blocks (seller left, buyer right): read each column with patterns that skip the
  other column, or use replace to drop it.
- Only field names from the FIELD LIST below. A field the list lacks may be declared in
  new_fields (document level) or new_line_fields (item table), with type text, date, money,
  rate, count or number; money fields that are part of the total need a role
  (tax, untaxed, total, other).
- amount is the final total payable of the document. Read every printed total you can (taxable
  value, each tax, round off) so the arithmetic checks can prove the values.
- ASCII only in the YAML; write a non-ASCII character as an escape such as '₹'.

CHECKS: by default the engine checks, where the values exist (names in brackets):
  per line: qty * price_unit - discount = line total [qty x unit price]; gross - discount
  [gross - discount]; taxable + taxes = line total [taxable value + tax]; rate * taxable = tax
  [cgst rate], [sgst rate], [igst rate], [cess rate], [line tax rate]
  per document: [line tax vs document tax]; [untaxed + tax + adjustments = total];
  [paid + due = total]; [due = total]; and for every line column the sum of the lines equals the
  document total it adds up to ("sum of line price_total vs amount", ...).
A document is OK only when at least one check with non-zero values passes. Disable a default
check (by its name in brackets) only when the document's own arithmetic differs (for example MRP
includes tax), and add the rule it does follow. The "sum of line ..." checks can never be

row is read and the document prints its total rounded (to whole rupees) without a round-off

put in a standard form: "Label :" is written "Label:", trailing spaces removed, shared
indentation removed, at most one blank line in a row. Columns are separated by 2+ spaces.

PATTERN RULES
- Accept small print variations: \s* around colons, \s+ between words, amounts as
  (\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?) so 212.1, 212.10 and 17.582 all match.
- Use (?m) with ^ or $, (?s) when . must cross lines. Never write a pattern that can take a
  value from a different column of the same line: stop at 2+ spaces (\s{2,}) when a right-hand
  column follows.
- Blocks printed side by side (Bill To | Ship To, Sold By | Billing Address): read a block with
  parser: region, which takes the words below a heading inside its column from their positions on
  the page, so the next column cannot run into it:
    buyer_name: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', max_lines: 1}
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', skip: 1, stop: '^Phone'}
  (skip: lines left out at the top; stop: the line that ends the block, not included; join: what
  goes between the lines, default one space, ', ' for an address printed without commas). A
  label with its value on the same line and more lines hanging under the value ("Address: Flat
  12, ..." | "Place of Supply: ..." on the right) is read with same_line: true; the next label
  at the left ("Pincode:") ends it:

  The heading is a regex on the heading's line as it reads ("Address:" even when the PDF draws
  the colon apart). Use region for left-aligned blocks; a block aligned right or centred under
  its heading, or one without a heading, needs a regex.
- Only field names from the FIELD LIST below. A field the list lacks may be declared in
  new_fields (document level) or new_line_fields (item table), with type text, date, money,
  rate, count or number; money fields that are part of the total need a role
  (tax, untaxed, total, other).
- invoice_number is the document's own number and contains digits. When the document prints its
  invoice number as N.A. or NA (e-tickets, booking slips), read the number that identifies this
  transaction instead (transaction ID, booking or order number), never a label or heading.
- amount is the final total payable of the document. Read every printed total you can (taxable
  value, each tax, round off) so the arithmetic checks can prove the values.
- ASCII only in the YAML; write a non-ASCII character as an escape such as '₹'.

INDIAN INVOICE VARIATIONS: the template must read the NEXT documents of this layout too, not only
this one. Cover these even when this document does not show them:
- Tax: a seller in another state charges IGST; in the buyer's state CGST + SGST (UTGST in a union
  territory); CESS can be added. An item table lists igst_amount, cgst_amount AND sgst_amount
  (heading 'SGST|UTGST'), and cess_amount when a CESS heading may appear; document totals read
  amount_igst, amount_cgst and amount_sgst as optional_fields. Use parser: table for the items.
- Rows: several items; descriptions wrapping over lines; charge rows (shipping, handling, COD,
  gift wrap, platform or convenience fee) with or without qty and discount.
- Pages: the table can continue on the next page with its header printed again; later pages need
  continuation_keywords printed on every page.
- Numbers: 1,499.00 / 1499 / 1,499.0 / 1,23,456.00; minus as -135.00, (135.00) or 135.00-; the
  rupee sign before or after, joined or apart. Amount patterns: (-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?).
- Units: weight in g or kg; quantity as 2 or "2 Nos".
- Optional parts: buyer GSTIN (business purchases only), CIN, FSSAI, state, place of supply are
  printed on some documents only: list them in optional_fields, never in required_fields.

CHECKS: by default the engine checks, where the values exist (names in brackets):
  per line: qty * price_unit - discount = line total [qty x unit price]; gross - discount

  [cgst rate], [sgst rate], [igst rate], [cess rate], [line tax rate]

A document is OK only when at least one check with non-zero values passes. Disable a default
check (by its name in brackets) only when the document's own arithmetic differs (for example MRP

# MakeMyTrip (India) Private Limited - GST tax invoice for cab / travel services.
# The invoice carries its own number, date, booking id and the PAYMENT BREAKUP
# list (the charge rows add up to the Grand Total); the footer (Registered Office
# block, printed on every page) attaches any following page to the document.
issuer: MakeMyTrip (India) Private Limited

keywords:
  - 'MAKEMYTRIP (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED'
  - 'TAX INVOICE'
  - 'Booking ID'
  - 'PAYMENT BREAKUP'

continuation_keywords:
  - 'Registered Office'

required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name, buyer_name]
# IGST / CGST+SGST, buyer GSTIN, CIN, place of supply and the vendor column are
# printed on some documents of this layout only.
optional_fields: [booking_reference, buyer_tax_id, seller_address, seller_tax_id, seller_pan, seller_company_reg, place_of_supply, hsn_sac, supply_description, reverse_charge, operator_name, amount_igst, amount_cgst, amount_sgst]

fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}
  invoice_number: '(?m)^Invoice No\.\s*\n\s*(\S+)'
  date: '(?m)^Date\s*\n\s*(\d{1,2}\s+[A-Za-z]{3,9}\s+\d{4})'
  booking_reference: '(?m)^Booking ID\s*\n\s*(\S+)'

  seller_name: '(MAKEMYTRIP \(INDIA\) PRIVATE LIMITED)'
  # the address is split over four lines and shares one line with "TAX INVOICE"
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)PRIVATE LIMITED\s*\n\s*(.*?)\n\s*Booking ID', replace: [['TAX INVOICE\s+', ''], ['\s+', ' ']]}
  seller_tax_id: '(?m)^GSTIN\s*\n\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})'
  seller_pan: 'PAN\s*\n\s*([A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z])'
  seller_company_reg: 'CIN\s*\n\s*([LU]\d{5}[A-Z]{2}\d{4}[A-Z]{3}\d{6})'
  hsn_sac: '(?m)^HSN/SAC\s*\n\s*(\d{4,8})'
  place_of_supply: '(?m)^Place of Supply\s*\n\s*(\S.*?)\s{2,}'

  reverse_charge: 'Tax Payable under RCM\s*\n\s*(\S+)'

  buyer_name: '(?m)^Customer Name\s*\n\s*(\S.*?)\s{2,}'
  buyer_tax_id: 'Customer GSTIN\s*\n\s*(\S+)'

  # "Vendor Name | Pick-up | Drop" are three side-by-side columns: read the vendor only
  operator_name: {parser: region, heading: '^Vendor Name', stop: '^\s*PAYMENT BREAKUP'}

    end: 'Grand Total'
    first_line: '^\s{2,}(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}INR\s*(?P<price_total>-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s{2,}(?P<name>\S.*?)\s*$'
    types:
      price_total: float

options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d %b %Y']
  replace:
    - ['\r', '']

TEMPLATE FORMAT (YAML; use single quotes around every regular expression)
Shapes: fields, options, checks, new_fields and new_line_fields are MAPPINGS (name: value), never
lists; keywords, exclude_keywords, continuation_keywords, required_fields and optional_fields are
LISTS of texts.
issuer: <company that issues the document>
keywords: [2 to 4 texts printed on EVERY document of this layout and on no other issuer's
           documents: the issuer's name, its fixed headings. NEVER a value that changes per
           document (customer name or address, numbers, dates, amounts). Each keyword is copied
           exactly from the text and lies inside one column: never across a gap of 2+ spaces.]
exclude_keywords: [optional: texts that appear only on a look-alike layout]
continuation_keywords: [texts printed on EVERY following page of the document that carries no
                        document number (GST details, terms, instructions, annexures); such a
                        page is attached to the document only when all of these are on it.
                        Needed whenever the document has more than one page.]
required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name, ...]
optional_fields: [fields printed on some documents of this layout only]
fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}     # tax_invoice, credit_note, receipt, ...
  invoice_number: 'Invoice No\.\s*:\s*(\S+)'             # exactly ONE capture group
  date: 'Invoice Date\s*:\s*(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})'
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)Sold By\s*\n(.*?)\nGSTIN', replace: [['\s+', ' ']]}
  tax_rate: {parser: regex, regex: '([\d.]+)%\s+IGST', type: float}
  amount: 'Grand Total\s+(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?)'
  lines:                                                  # the item table
    parser: lines
    start: 'Description\s+Qty\s+Amount'                   # a regex on the header line
    end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                                  # a regex on the line after the table
    first_line: '^\s*(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?P<qty>\d+)\s+(?P<price_total>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s{4,}(?P<name>\S.*?)\s*$'                   # continuation lines of a row (optional)
    skip_line: '^\s*Page \d'                              # optional
    types: {qty: int, price_total: float}
  # PREFERRED for item tables that have a header row: read each value by its column heading.
  # Columns the document does not print are simply missing; a printed column you do not list is
  # not read. List every column a document of this issuer CAN print (IGST, or CGST + SGST/UTGST
  # when the seller is in the buyer's state, CESS, Discount), even if this document lacks some.
  # lines:
  #   parser: table
  #   start: '(?m)^\s*Description\s+Qty'          # a regex on the first header line
  #   end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                          # a regex on the line after the table
  #   columns: {name: 'Description', qty: 'Qty', price_unit: 'Rate', price_subtotal: 'Taxable',
  #             igst_amount: 'IGST', cgst_amount: 'CGST', sgst_amount: 'SGST', price_total: 'Total'}
  #   row: [price_total]                             # a row starts on a line with these values
  #   text: after                                    # description lines below the amounts row
  #   extra: ['^\s+HSN:\s*(?P<hsn_sac>\d+)']        # optional patterns for other row lines
  #   types: {qty: int, price_subtotal: float, igst_amount: float, cgst_amount: float, ...}
checks:                                                   # optional, see CHECKS
  disable: [qty x unit price]
  line: [{name: ..., rule: "qty * (price_unit - discount_unit) == price_total", tolerance: "0.01"}]
  document: [{name: ..., rule: "amount_untaxed + amount_cgst + amount_sgst == amount"}]

TEXT FORM: the text below is what the engine gives every template: pdftotext -layout output,
put in a standard form: "Label :" is written "Label:", trailing spaces removed, shared
indentation removed, at most one blank line in a row. Columns are separated by 2+ spaces.

PATTERN RULES
- Accept small print variations: \s* around colons, \s+ between words, amounts as
  (\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?) so 212.1, 212.10 and 17.582 all match.
- Use (?m) with ^ or $, (?s) when . must cross lines. Never write a pattern that can take a
  value from a different column of the same line: stop at 2+ spaces (\s{2,}) when a right-hand
  column follows.
- Blocks printed side by side (Bill To | Ship To, Sold By | Billing Address): read a block with
  parser: region, which takes the words below a heading inside its column from their positions on
  the page, so the next column cannot run into it:
    buyer_name: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', max_lines: 1}
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', skip: 1, stop: '^Phone'}
  (skip: lines left out at the top; stop: the line that ends the block, not included; join: what
  goes between the lines, default one space, ', ' for an address printed without commas). A
  label with its value on the same line and more lines hanging under the value ("Address: Flat
  12, ..." | "Place of Supply: ..." on the right) is read with same_line: true; the next label
  at the left ("Pincode:") ends it:
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: '^Address:', same_line: true}
  The heading is a regex on the heading's line as it reads ("Address:" even when the PDF draws
  the colon apart). Labels printed above their values in a grid of columns ("Invoice No.  HSN/SAC"
  with "M06CR26I00621384  998551" on the next line) are read the same way, one field per label:
    hsn_sac: {parser: region, heading: 'HSN/SAC', max_lines: 1}
  A regex such as 'HSN/SAC\s*\n[^\n]*?(\d{4,8})' takes digits from the left column's value instead.
  Use region for left-aligned blocks; a block aligned right or centred under
  its heading, or one without a heading, needs a regex.
- Only field names from the FIELD LIST below. A field the list lacks may be declared in
  new_fields (document level) or new_line_fields (item table), with type text, date, money,
  rate, count or number; money fields that are part of the total need a role
  (tax, untaxed, total, other).
- invoice_number is the document's own number and contains digits. When the document prints its
  invoice number as N.A. or NA (e-tickets, booking slips), read the number that identifies this
  transaction instead (transaction ID, booking or order number), never a label or heading.
- amount is the final total payable of the document. Read every printed total you can (taxable

# IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation) - GST tax invoice for a flight booking (per PNR).
# The table cells are narrow: amounts of 10,000.00 and more are printed over two lines
# ("13,055.0" with "0" below it, "14,088." with "00" below it). options.replace joins them
# back before any field is read.
issuer: IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation)

keywords:
  - 'InterGlobe Aviation Limited'
  - 'Tax Invoice'
  - 'GSTIN of Customer'
exclude_keywords:
  - 'Credit Note'

required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name]

fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}
  invoice_number: '(?m)^Number\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  date: '(?m)^Date\s*:\s*(\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{4})'
  booking_reference: 'PNR\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  flight_number: 'Flight No\s*:\s*(\S+(?: - \S+)?)'
  travel_from: 'From\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  travel_to: '\bTo\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  place_of_supply: 'Place of Supply\s*:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s*\n'

  seller_name: 'Tax Invoice\s+(InterGlobe Aviation Limited)'
  # Right column under the name, up to the GSTIN; the left column only holds the copy label
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)Tax Invoice\s+InterGlobe Aviation Limited[^\n]*\n(.*?)\n\s*GSTIN\s*:', replace: [['\((?:Original|Duplicate)[^)]*\)', ''], ['\s+', ' '], ['^\s|\s$', '']]}
  seller_tax_id: '(?m)^\s+GSTIN\s*:\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})'
  seller_pan: 'PAN no\.\s*([A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z])'
  seller_company_reg: 'CIN no\.\s*(\S+?),'

  buyer_tax_id: 'GSTIN of Customer\s*:\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})'
  buyer_name: 'GSTIN Customer Name\s*:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s*\n'

  # Grand Total row (after the split numbers are joined):
  # taxable, non-taxable/exempt, total value, IGST, CGST, SGST/UGST, CESS, total incl. taxes
  amount_untaxed: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){7}\s*$'
  amount_exempt: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){6}\s*$'
  amount_value_before_tax: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){2}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){5}\s*$'
  amount_igst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){3}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){4}\s*$'
  amount_cgst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){4}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){3}\s*$'
  amount_sgst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){5}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){2}\s*$'
  amount_cess: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){6}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s*$'
  amount: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){7}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s*$'

  lines:
    parser: lines
    start: 'Taxes\)\s*\n\s*ed Value'
    end: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total'
    # "Air Travel and  996425  13,055.00  0.00  13,055.00  0.00 0.00  2.50 326.00  2.50 326.00  0 0.00  13,707.00"
    # The SAC code is empty on some rows (Airport Charges).
    first_line: '^\s*(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?:(?P<hsn_sac>\d{6})\s+)?(?P<price_subtotal>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<exempt_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<value_before_tax>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<igst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<igst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<cgst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<cgst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<sgst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<sgst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<cess_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<cess_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<price_total>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z].*?)\s*$'
    types:
      price_subtotal: float
      exempt_amount: float
      value_before_tax: float
      igst_rate: float
      igst_amount: float
      cgst_rate: float
      cgst_amount: float
      sgst_rate: float
      sgst_amount: float
      cess_rate: float
      cess_amount: float
      price_total: float

checks:
  # IndiGo rounds tax amounts ("Amounts have been rounded off"): on the samples the printed
  # CGST/SGST is up to 0.53 below the rate times the value, so the rate checks allow 1.00.
  # The document checks (value + tax = total) stay exact. IndiGo also adds the
  # non-taxable value (airport charges) to the line and grand totals.
  disable: [cgst rate, sgst rate, igst rate, cess rate, taxable value + tax, untaxed + tax + adjustments = total]
  line:
    - {name: cgst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * cgst_rate / 100) == cgst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: sgst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * sgst_rate / 100) == sgst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: igst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * igst_rate / 100) == igst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: cess rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * cess_rate / 100) == cess_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: taxable + exempt = value, rule: "price_subtotal + exempt_amount == value_before_tax"}
    - {name: value + tax = total, rule: "value_before_tax + taxes() == price_total", tolerance: "0.01 * n_taxes"}
  document:
    - {name: taxable + exempt = value, rule: "amount_untaxed + amount_exempt == amount_value_before_tax"}
    - {name: value + tax = total, rule: "amount_value_before_tax + tax_total() == amount"}

options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d-%b-%Y']
  replace:
    - ['\r', '']
    # Fares under 10,000: the row is printed over two lines, the 8 tax columns on the name line
    # and SAC, the 3 values and the total on the line below. Put them back into one row in
    # column order.
    - ['(?m)^( +\S.*?\S) {2,}((?:[\d.,]+ +){7}[\d.,]+) *\n +(\d{6}) +([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) +([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) +([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) +([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) *$', '\1       \3 \4 \5 \6 \2 \7']
    # Join amounts split over two lines (see the note at the top). Most specific first:
    # 1. Grand Total: taxable value split above the row, total value split in the row
    - ['(?m)^ *(\d[\d,]*\.\d?) *\n( *Grand Total +)(.*?\d,\d{3}\.\d?(?= ))(.*)\n *(\d{1,2}) +(\d{1,2}) *$', '\2\1\5 \3\6\4']
    # 2. a row with two split amounts, endings on the next line
    - ['(?m)^(.*?\d,\d{3}\.\d?(?= ))(.*?\d,\d{3}\.\d?(?= ))(.*)\n(.*?) (\d{1,2}) +(\d{1,2}) *$', '\1\5\2\6\3\n\4']
    # 3. a row with one split amount
    - ['(?m)^(.*?\d,\d{3}\.\d?(?= ))(.*)\n(.*?) (\d{1,2}) *$', '\1\4\2\n\3']

PATTERN RULES
- Accept small print variations: \s* around colons, \s+ between words, amounts as
  (\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?) so 212.1, 212.10 and 17.582 all match.
- Use (?m) with ^ or $, (?s) when . must cross lines. Never write a pattern that can take a
  value from a different column of the same line: stop at 2+ spaces (\s{2,}) when a right-hand
  column follows.
- Blocks printed side by side (Bill To | Ship To, Sold By | Billing Address): read a block with
  parser: region, which takes the words below a heading inside its column from their positions on
  the page, so the next column cannot run into it:
    buyer_name: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', max_lines: 1}
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', skip: 1, stop: '^Phone'}
  (skip: lines left out at the top; stop: the line that ends the block, not included; join: what
  goes between the lines, default one space, ', ' for an address printed without commas). A
  label with its value on the same line and more lines hanging under the value ("Address: Flat
  12, ..." | "Place of Supply: ..." on the right) is read with same_line: true; the next label
  at the left ("Pincode:") ends it:
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: '^Address:', same_line: true}
  The heading is a regex on the heading's line as it reads ("Address:" even when the PDF draws
  the colon apart). Labels printed above their values in a grid of columns ("Invoice No.  HSN/SAC"
  with "M06CR26I00621384  998551" on the next line) are read the same way, one field per label:
    hsn_sac: {parser: region, heading: 'HSN/SAC', max_lines: 1}
  A regex such as 'HSN/SAC\s*\n[^\n]*?(\d{4,8})' takes digits from the left column's value instead.

prompt:
TEMPLATE FORMAT (YAML; use single quotes around every regular expression)
Shapes: fields, options, checks, new_fields and new_line_fields are MAPPINGS (name: value), never
lists; keywords, exclude_keywords, continuation_keywords, required_fields and optional_fields are
LISTS of texts.
issuer: <company that issues the document>
keywords: [2 to 4 texts printed on EVERY document of this layout and on no other issuer's
           documents: the issuer's name, its fixed headings. NEVER a value that changes per
           document (customer name or address, numbers, dates, amounts). Each keyword is copied
           exactly from the text and lies inside one column: never across a gap of 2+ spaces.]
exclude_keywords: [optional: texts that appear only on a look-alike layout]
continuation_keywords: [texts printed on EVERY following page of the document that carries no
                        document number (GST details, terms, instructions, annexures); such a
                        page is attached to the document only when all of these are on it.
                        Needed whenever the document has more than one page.]
required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name, ...]
optional_fields: [fields printed on some documents of this layout only]
fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}     # tax_invoice, credit_note, receipt, ...
  invoice_number: 'Invoice No\.\s*:\s*(\S+)'             # exactly ONE capture group
  date: 'Invoice Date\s*:\s*(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})'
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)Sold By\s*\n(.*?)\nGSTIN', replace: [['\s+', ' ']]}
  tax_rate: {parser: regex, regex: '([\d.]+)%\s+IGST', type: float}
  amount: 'Grand Total\s+(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?)'
  lines:                                                  # the item table
    parser: lines
    start: 'Description\s+Qty\s+Amount'                   # a regex on the header line
    end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                                  # a regex on the line after the table
    first_line: '^\s*(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?P<qty>\d+)\s+(?P<price_total>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s{4,}(?P<name>\S.*?)\s*$'                   # continuation lines of a row (optional)
    skip_line: '^\s*Page \d'                              # optional
    types: {qty: int, price_total: float}
  # PREFERRED for item tables that have a header row: read each value by its column heading.
  # Columns the document does not print are simply missing; a printed column you do not list is
  # not read. List every column a document of this issuer CAN print (IGST, or CGST + SGST/UTGST
  # when the seller is in the buyer's state, CESS, Discount), even if this document lacks some.
  # lines:
  #   parser: table
  #   start: '(?m)^\s*Description\s+Qty'          # a regex on the first header line
  #   end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                          # a regex on the line after the table
  #   columns: {name: 'Description', qty: 'Qty', price_unit: 'Rate', price_subtotal: 'Taxable',
  #             igst_amount: 'IGST', cgst_amount: 'CGST', sgst_amount: 'SGST', price_total: 'Total'}
  #   row: [price_total]                             # a row starts on a line with these values
  #   text: after                                    # description lines below the amounts row
  #   extra: ['^\s+HSN:\s*(?P<hsn_sac>\d+)']        # optional patterns for other row lines
  #   types: {qty: int, price_subtotal: float, igst_amount: float, cgst_amount: float, ...}
checks:                                                   # optional, see CHECKS
  disable: [qty x unit price]
  line: [{name: ..., rule: "qty * (price_unit - discount_unit) == price_total", tolerance: "0.01"}]
  document: [{name: ..., rule: "amount_untaxed + amount_cgst + amount_sgst == amount"}]
options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d/%m/%Y']                              # REQUIRED when dates are numeric
  replace: [['\r', '']]

TEXT FORM: the text below is what the engine gives every template: pdftotext -layout output,
put in a standard form: "Label :" is written "Label:", trailing spaces removed, shared
indentation removed, at most one blank line in a row. Columns are separated by 2+ spaces.

PATTERN RULES
- Accept small print variations: \s* around colons, \s+ between words, amounts as
  (\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?) so 212.1, 212.10 and 17.582 all match.
- Use (?m) with ^ or $, (?s) when . must cross lines. Never write a pattern that can take a
  value from a different column of the same line: stop at 2+ spaces (\s{2,}) when a right-hand
  column follows.
- Blocks printed side by side (Bill To | Ship To, Sold By | Billing Address): read a block with
  parser: region, which takes the words below a heading inside its column from their positions on
  the page, so the next column cannot run into it:
    buyer_name: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', max_lines: 1}
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', skip: 1, stop: '^Phone'}
  (skip: lines left out at the top; stop: the line that ends the block, not included; join: what
  goes between the lines, default one space, ', ' for an address printed without commas). A
  label with its value on the same line and more lines hanging under the value ("Address: Flat
  12, ..." | "Place of Supply: ..." on the right) is read with same_line: true; the next label
  at the left ("Pincode:") ends it:
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: '^Address:', same_line: true}
  The heading is a regex on the heading's line as it reads ("Address:" even when the PDF draws
  the colon apart). Labels printed above their values in a grid of columns ("Invoice No.  HSN/SAC"
  with "M06CR26I00621384  998551" on the next line) are read the same way, one field per label:
    hsn_sac: {parser: region, heading: 'HSN/SAC', max_lines: 1}
  A regex such as 'HSN/SAC\s*\n[^\n]*?(\d{4,8})' takes digits from the left column's value instead.
  Use region for left-aligned blocks; a block aligned right or centred under
  its heading, or one without a heading, needs a regex.
- Only field names from the FIELD LIST below. A field the list lacks may be declared in
  new_fields (document level) or new_line_fields (item table), with type text, date, money,
  rate, count or number; money fields that are part of the total need a role
  (tax, untaxed, total, other).
- invoice_number is the document's own number and contains digits. When the document prints its
  invoice number as N.A. or NA (e-tickets, booking slips), read the number that identifies this
  transaction instead (transaction ID, booking or order number), never a label or heading.
- amount is the final total payable of the document. Read every printed total you can (taxable
  value, each tax, round off) so the arithmetic checks can prove the values.
- ASCII only in the YAML; write a non-ASCII character as an escape such as '₹'.

INDIAN INVOICE VARIATIONS: the template must read the NEXT documents of this layout too, not only
this one. Cover these even when this document does not show them:
- Tax: a seller in another state charges IGST; in the buyer's state CGST + SGST (UTGST in a union
  territory); CESS can be added. An item table lists igst_amount, cgst_amount AND sgst_amount
  (heading 'SGST|UTGST'), and cess_amount when a CESS heading may appear; document totals read
  amount_igst, amount_cgst and amount_sgst as optional_fields. Use parser: table for the items.
- Rows: several items; descriptions wrapping over lines; charge rows (shipping, handling, COD,
  gift wrap, platform or convenience fee) with or without qty and discount.
- Pages: the table can continue on the next page with its header printed again; later pages need
  continuation_keywords printed on every page.
- Numbers: 1,499.00 / 1499 / 1,499.0 / 1,23,456.00; minus as -135.00, (135.00) or 135.00-; the
  rupee sign before or after, joined or apart. Amount patterns: (-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?).
- Units: weight in g or kg; quantity as 2 or "2 Nos".
- Optional parts: buyer GSTIN (business purchases only), CIN, FSSAI, state, place of supply are
  printed on some documents only: list them in optional_fields, never in required_fields.

CHECKS: by default the engine checks, where the values exist (names in brackets):
  per line: qty * price_unit - discount = line total [qty x unit price]; gross - discount
  [gross - discount]; taxable + taxes = line total [taxable value + tax]; rate * taxable = tax
  [cgst rate], [sgst rate], [igst rate], [cess rate], [line tax rate]
  per document: [line tax vs document tax]; [untaxed + tax + adjustments = total];
  [paid + due = total]; [due = total]; and for every line column the sum of the lines equals the
  document total it adds up to ("sum of line price_total vs amount", ...).
A document is OK only when at least one check with non-zero values passes. Disable a default
check (by its name in brackets) only when the document's own arithmetic differs (for example MRP
includes tax), and add the rule it does follow. The "sum of line ..." checks can never be
disabled: when the lines do not add up to the total, a row is missing or misread, so fix the
line patterns (every row of the table must be read, including fees and charges). Only when every
row is read and the document prints its total rounded (to whole rupees) without a round-off
line, add the top-level settings total_rounding: 1 and total_rounding_mode: up (the total is the
sum rounded up, e.g. 518.15 -> 519), nearest (1378.40 -> 1378) or down; the check then compares the
rounded sum exactly. When this document fits more than one rule (1378.60 -> 1379 is both up and
nearest), list every rule that fits: total_rounding_mode: [up, nearest]; a later document settles it.

EXAMPLE OF A WORKING TEMPLATE (another issuer; for the format only):
# IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation) - GST tax invoice for a flight booking (per PNR).
# The table cells are narrow: amounts of 10,000.00 and more are printed over two lines
# ("13,055.0" with "0" below it, "14,088." with "00" below it). options.replace joins them
# back before any field is read.
issuer: IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation)

keywords:
  - 'InterGlobe Aviation Limited'
  - 'Tax Invoice'
  - 'GSTIN of Customer'
exclude_keywords:
  - 'Credit Note'

required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name]

fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}
  invoice_number: '(?m)^Number\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  date: '(?m)^Date\s*:\s*(\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{4})'
  booking_reference: 'PNR\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  flight_number: 'Flight No\s*:\s*(\S+(?: - \S+)?)'
  travel_from: 'From\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  travel_to: '\bTo\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  place_of_supply: 'Place of Supply\s*:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s*\n'

  seller_name: 'Tax Invoice\s+(InterGlobe Aviation Limited)'
  # Right column under the name, up to the GSTIN; the left column only holds the copy label
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)Tax Invoice\s+InterGlobe Aviation Limited[^\n]*\n(.*?)\n\s*GSTIN\s*:', replace: [['\((?:Original|Duplicate)[^)]*\)', ''], ['\s+', ' '], ['^\s|\s$', '']]}
  seller_tax_id: '(?m)^\s+GSTIN\s*:\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})'
  seller_pan: 'PAN no\.\s*([A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z])'
  seller_company_reg: 'CIN no\.\s*(\S+?),'

  buyer_tax_id: 'GSTIN of Customer\s*:\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})'
  buyer_name: 'GSTIN Customer Name\s*:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s*\n'

  # Grand Total row (after the split numbers are joined):
  # taxable, non-taxable/exempt, total value, IGST, CGST, SGST/UGST, CESS, total incl. taxes
  amount_untaxed: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){7}\s*$'
  amount_exempt: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){6}\s*$'
  amount_value_before_tax: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){2}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){5}\s*$'
  amount_igst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){3}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){4}\s*$'
  amount_cgst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){4}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){3}\s*$'
  amount_sgst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){5}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){2}\s*$'
  amount_cess: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){6}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s*$'
  amount: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){7}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s*$'

  lines:
    parser: lines
    start: 'Taxes\)\s*\n\s*ed Value'
    end: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total'
    # "Air Travel and  996425  13,055.00  0.00  13,055.00  0.00 0.00  2.50 326.00  2.50 326.00  0 0.00  13,707.00"
    # The SAC code is empty on some rows (Airport Charges).
    first_line: '^\s*(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?:(?P<hsn_sac>\d{6})\s+)?(?P<price_subtotal>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<exempt_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<value_before_tax>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<igst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<igst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<cgst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<cgst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<sgst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<sgst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<cess_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<cess_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<price_total>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z].*?)\s*$'
    types:
      price_subtotal: float
      exempt_amount: float
      value_before_tax: float
      igst_rate: float
      igst_amount: float
      cgst_rate: float
      cgst_amount: float
      sgst_rate: float
      sgst_amount: float
      cess_rate: float
      cess_amount: float
      price_total: float

checks:
  # IndiGo rounds tax amounts ("Amounts have been rounded off"): on the samples the printed
  # CGST/SGST is up to 0.53 below the rate times the value, so the rate checks allow 1.00.
  # The document checks (value + tax = total) stay exact. IndiGo also adds the
  # non-taxable value (airport charges) to the line and grand totals.
  disable: [cgst rate, sgst rate, igst rate, cess rate, taxable value + tax, untaxed + tax + adjustments = total]
  line:
    - {name: cgst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * cgst_rate / 100) == cgst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: sgst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * sgst_rate / 100) == sgst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: igst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * igst_rate / 100) == igst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: cess rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * cess_rate / 100) == cess_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: taxable + exempt = value, rule: "price_subtotal + exempt_amount == value_before_tax"}
    - {name: value + tax = total, rule: "value_before_tax + taxes() == price_total", tolerance: "0.01 * n_taxes"}
  document:
    - {name: taxable + exempt = value, rule: "amount_untaxed + amount_exempt == amount_value_before_tax"}
    - {name: value + tax = total, rule: "amount_value_before_tax + tax_total() == amount"}

options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d-%b-%Y']
  replace:
    - ['\r', '']
    # Fares under 10,000: the row is printed over two lines, the 8 tax columns on the name line

TEMPLATE FORMAT (YAML; use single quotes around every regular expression)
Shapes: fields, options, checks, new_fields and new_line_fields are MAPPINGS (name: value), never
lists; keywords, exclude_keywords, continuation_keywords, required_fields and optional_fields are
LISTS of texts.
issuer: <company that issues the document>
keywords: [2 to 4 texts printed on EVERY document of this layout and on no other issuer's
           documents: the issuer's name, its fixed headings. NEVER a value that changes per
           document (customer name or address, numbers, dates, amounts). Each keyword is copied
           exactly from the text and lies inside one column: never across a gap of 2+ spaces.]
exclude_keywords: [optional: texts that appear only on a look-alike layout]
continuation_keywords: [texts printed on EVERY following page of the document that carries no
                        document number (GST details, terms, instructions, annexures); such a
                        page is attached to the document only when all of these are on it.
                        Needed whenever the document has more than one page.]
required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name, ...]
optional_fields: [fields printed on some documents of this layout only]
fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}     # tax_invoice, credit_note, receipt, ...
  invoice_number: 'Invoice No\.\s*:\s*(\S+)'             # exactly ONE capture group
  date: 'Invoice Date\s*:\s*(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})'
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)Sold By\s*\n(.*?)\nGSTIN', replace: [['\s+', ' ']]}
  tax_rate: {parser: regex, regex: '([\d.]+)%\s+IGST', type: float}
  amount: 'Grand Total\s+(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?)'
  lines:                                                  # the item table
    parser: lines
    start: 'Description\s+Qty\s+Amount'                   # a regex on the header line
    end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                                  # a regex on the line after the table
    first_line: '^\s*(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?P<qty>\d+)\s+(?P<price_total>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s{4,}(?P<name>\S.*?)\s*$'                   # continuation lines of a row (optional)
    skip_line: '^\s*Page \d'                              # optional
    types: {qty: int, price_total: float}
  # PREFERRED for item tables that have a header row: read each value by its column heading.
  # Columns the document does not print are simply missing; a printed column you do not list is
  # not read. List every column a document of this issuer CAN print (IGST, or CGST + SGST/UTGST
  # when the seller is in the buyer's state, CESS, Discount), even if this document lacks some.
  # lines:
  #   parser: table
  #   start: '(?m)^\s*Description\s+Qty'          # a regex on the first header line
  #   end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                          # a regex on the line after the table
  #   columns: {name: 'Description', qty: 'Qty', price_unit: 'Rate', price_subtotal: 'Taxable',
  #             igst_amount: 'IGST', cgst_amount: 'CGST', sgst_amount: 'SGST', price_total: 'Total'}
  #   row: [price_total]                             # a row starts on a line with these values
  #   text: after                                    # description lines below the amounts row
  #   extra: ['^\s+HSN:\s*(?P<hsn_sac>\d+)']        # optional patterns for other row lines
  #   types: {qty: int, price_subtotal: float, igst_amount: float, cgst_amount: float, ...}
checks:                                                   # optional, see CHECKS
  disable: [qty x unit price]
  line: [{name: ..., rule: "qty * (price_unit - discount_unit) == price_total", tolerance: "0.01"}]
  document: [{name: ..., rule: "amount_untaxed + amount_cgst + amount_sgst == amount"}]
options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d/%m/%Y']                              # REQUIRED when dates are numeric
  replace: [['\r', '']]

TEXT FORM: the text below is what the engine gives every template: pdftotext -layout output,
put in a standard form: "Label :" is written "Label:", trailing spaces removed, shared
indentation removed, at most one blank line in a row. Columns are separated by 2+ spaces.

PATTERN RULES
- Accept small print variations: \s* around colons, \s+ between words, amounts as
  (\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?) so 212.1, 212.10 and 17.582 all match.
- Use (?m) with ^ or $, (?s) when . must cross lines. Never write a pattern that can take a
  value from a different column of the same line: stop at 2+ spaces (\s{2,}) when a right-hand
  column follows.
- Blocks printed side by side (Bill To | Ship To, Sold By | Billing Address): read a block with
  parser: region, which takes the words below a heading inside its column from their positions on
  the page, so the next column cannot run into it:
    buyer_name: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', max_lines: 1}
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', skip: 1, stop: '^Phone'}
  (skip: lines left out at the top; stop: the line that ends the block, not included; join: what
  goes between the lines, default one space, ', ' for an address printed without commas). A
  label with its value on the same line and more lines hanging under the value ("Address: Flat
  12, ..." | "Place of Supply: ..." on the right) is read with same_line: true; the next label
  at the left ("Pincode:") ends it:
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: '^Address:', same_line: true}

  its heading, or one without a heading, needs a regex.
- Only field names from the FIELD LIST below. A field the list lacks may be declared in
  new_fields (document level) or new_line_fields (item table), with type text, date, money,
  rate, count or number; money fields that are part of the total need a role
  (tax, untaxed, total, other).
- invoice_number is the document's own number and contains digits. When the document prints its
  invoice number as N.A. or NA (e-tickets, booking slips), read the number that identifies this
  transaction instead (transaction ID, booking or order number), never a label or heading.
- amount is the final total payable of the document. Read every printed total you can (taxable
  value, each tax, round off) so the arithmetic checks can prove the values.
- ASCII only in the YAML; write a non-ASCII character as an escape such as '₹'.

INDIAN INVOICE VARIATIONS: the template must read the NEXT documents of this layout too, not only
this one. Cover these even when this document does not show them:
- Tax: a seller in another state charges IGST; in the buyer's state CGST + SGST (UTGST in a union
  territory); CESS can be added. An item table lists igst_amount, cgst_amount AND sgst_amount
  (heading 'SGST|UTGST'), and cess_amount when a CESS heading may appear; document totals read
  amount_igst, amount_cgst and amount_sgst as optional_fields. Use parser: table for the items.
- Rows: several items; descriptions wrapping over lines; charge rows (shipping, handling, COD,
  gift wrap, platform or convenience fee) with or without qty and discount.
- Pages: the table can continue on the next page with its header printed again; later pages need
  continuation_keywords printed on every page.
- Numbers: 1,499.00 / 1499 / 1,499.0 / 1,23,456.00; minus as -135.00, (135.00) or 135.00-; the
  rupee sign before or after, joined or apart. Amount patterns: (-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?).
- Units: weight in g or kg; quantity as 2 or "2 Nos".
- Optional parts: buyer GSTIN (business purchases only), CIN, FSSAI, state, place of supply are
  printed on some documents only: list them in optional_fields, never in required_fields.

  per line: qty * price_unit - discount = line total [qty x unit price]; gross - discount
  [gross - discount]; taxable + taxes = line total [taxable value + tax]; rate * taxable = tax
  [cgst rate], [sgst rate], [igst rate], [cess rate], [line tax rate]
  per document: [line tax vs document tax]; [untaxed + tax + adjustments = total];
  [paid + due = total]; [due = total]; and for every line column the sum of the lines equals the
  document total it adds up to ("sum of line price_total vs amount", ...).
A document is OK only when at least one check with non-zero values passes. Disable a default
check (by its name in brackets) only when the document's own arithmetic differs (for example MRP
includes tax), and add the rule it does follow. The "sum of line ..." checks can never be
disabled: when the lines do not add up to the total, a row is missing or misread, so fix the
line patterns (every row of the table must be read, including fees and charges). Only when every
row is read and the document prints its total rounded (to whole rupees) without a round-off
line, add the top-level settings total_rounding: 1 and total_rounding_mode: up (the total is the
sum rounded up, e.g. 518.15 -> 519), nearest (1378.40 -> 1378) or down; the check then compares the
rounded sum exactly. When this document fits more than one rule (1378.60 -> 1379 is both up and
nearest), list every rule that fits: total_rounding_mode: [up, nearest]; a later document settles it.

EXAMPLE OF A WORKING TEMPLATE (another issuer; for the format only):
# IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation) - GST tax invoice for a flight booking (per PNR).
# The table cells are narrow: amounts of 10,000.00 and more are printed over two lines
# ("13,055.0" with "0" below it, "14,088." with "00" below it). options.replace joins them
# back before any field is read.
issuer: IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation)

keywords:
  - 'InterGlobe Aviation Limited'
  - 'Tax Invoice'
  - 'GSTIN of Customer'
exclude_keywords:
  - 'Credit Note'

required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name]

fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}
  invoice_number: '(?m)^Number\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  date: '(?m)^Date\s*:\s*(\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{4})'
  booking_reference: 'PNR\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  flight_number: 'Flight No\s*:\s*(\S+(?: - \S+)?)'
  travel_from: 'From\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  travel_to: '\bTo\s*:\s*(\S+)'
  place_of_supply: 'Place of Supply\s*:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s*\n'

  seller_name: 'Tax Invoice\s+(InterGlobe Aviation Limited)'
  # Right column under the name, up to the GSTIN; the left column only holds the copy label
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)Tax Invoice\s+InterGlobe Aviation Limited[^\n]*\n(.*?)\n\s*GSTIN\s*:', replace: [['\((?:Original|Duplicate)[^)]*\)', ''], ['\s+', ' '], ['^\s|\s$', '']]}
  seller_tax_id: '(?m)^\s+GSTIN\s*:\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})'
  seller_pan: 'PAN no\.\s*([A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z])'
  seller_company_reg: 'CIN no\.\s*(\S+?),'

  buyer_tax_id: 'GSTIN of Customer\s*:\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})'
  buyer_name: 'GSTIN Customer Name\s*:\s*(\S[^\n]*?)\s*\n'

  # Grand Total row (after the split numbers are joined):
  # taxable, non-taxable/exempt, total value, IGST, CGST, SGST/UGST, CESS, total incl. taxes
  amount_untaxed: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){7}\s*$'
  amount_exempt: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){6}\s*$'
  amount_value_before_tax: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){2}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){5}\s*$'
  amount_igst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){3}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){4}\s*$'
  amount_cgst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){4}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){3}\s*$'
  amount_sgst: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){5}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){2}\s*$'
  amount_cess: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){6}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?\s*$'
  amount: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total(?:\s+[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?){7}\s+([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s*$'

  lines:
    parser: lines
    start: 'Taxes\)\s*\n\s*ed Value'
    end: '(?m)^\s*Grand Total'
    # "Air Travel and  996425  13,055.00  0.00  13,055.00  0.00 0.00  2.50 326.00  2.50 326.00  0 0.00  13,707.00"
    # The SAC code is empty on some rows (Airport Charges).
    first_line: '^\s*(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?:(?P<hsn_sac>\d{6})\s+)?(?P<price_subtotal>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<exempt_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<value_before_tax>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<igst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<igst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<cgst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<cgst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<sgst_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<sgst_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<cess_rate>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<cess_amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+(?P<price_total>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z].*?)\s*$'
    types:
      price_subtotal: float
      exempt_amount: float
      value_before_tax: float
      igst_rate: float
      igst_amount: float
      cgst_rate: float
      cgst_amount: float
      sgst_rate: float
      sgst_amount: float
      cess_rate: float
      cess_amount: float
      price_total: float

checks:
  # IndiGo rounds tax amounts ("Amounts have been rounded off"): on the samples the printed
  # CGST/SGST is up to 0.53 below the rate times the value, so the rate checks allow 1.00.
  # The document checks (value + tax = total) stay exact. IndiGo also adds the
  # non-taxable value (airport charges) to the line and grand totals.
  disable: [cgst rate, sgst rate, igst rate, cess rate, taxable value + tax, untaxed + tax + adjustments = total]
  line:
    - {name: cgst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * cgst_rate / 100) == cgst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: sgst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * sgst_rate / 100) == sgst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: igst rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * igst_rate / 100) == igst_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: cess rate (rounded), rule: "round2(price_subtotal * cess_rate / 100) == cess_amount", tolerance: "1.0"}
    - {name: taxable + exempt = value, rule: "price_subtotal + exempt_amount == value_before_tax"}
    - {name: value + tax = total, rule: "value_before_tax + taxes() == price_total", tolerance: "0.01 * n_taxes"}
  document:
    - {name: taxable + exempt = value, rule: "amount_untaxed + amount_exempt == amount_value_before_tax"}
    - {name: value + tax = total, rule: "amount_value_before_tax + tax_total() == amount"}

options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d-%b-%Y']
  replace:
    - ['\r', '']
    # Fares under 10,000: the row is printed over two lines, the 8 tax columns on the name line
    # and SAC, the 3 values and the total on the line below. Put them back into one row in
    # column order.
    - ['(?m)^( +\S.*?\S) {2,}((?:[\d.,]+ +){7}[\d.,]+) *\n +(\d{6}) +([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) +([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) +([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) +([\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) *$', '\1       \3 \4 \5 \6 \2 \7']
    # Join amounts split over two lines (see the note at the top). Most specific first:
    # 1. Grand Total: taxable value split above the row, total value split in the row
    - ['(?m)^ *(\d[\d,]*\.\d?) *\n( *Grand Total +)(.*?\d,\d{3}\.\d?(?= ))(.*)\n *(\d{1,2}) +(\d{1,2}) *$', '\2\1\5 \3\6\4']
    # 2. a row with two split amounts, endings on the next line
    - ['(?m)^(.*?\d,\d{3}\.\d?(?= ))(.*?\d,\d{3}\.\d?(?= ))(.*)\n(.*?) (\d{1,2}) +(\d{1,2}) *$', '\1\5\2\6\3\n\4']
    # 3. a row with one split amount
    - ['(?m)^(.*?\d,\d{3}\.\d?(?= ))(.*)\n(.*?) (\d{1,2}) *$', '\1\4\2\n\3']

  seller_tax_id: '(?m)GSTIN Number:\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})'

fields:
  document_type:
    parser: static
    value: tax_invoice
  invoice_number: (?m)^\s*Invoice Number:\s*(\S+)
  date: (?m)^\s*Invoice Number:\s*\S+\s{2,}Date:\s*(\d{1,2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} \d{4})
  order_number: (?m)^\s*Order Number:\s*(\S+)
  date_order: (?m)^\s*Order Number:\s*\S+\s{2,}Date:\s*(\d{1,2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} \d{4})
  nature_of_transaction: (?m)^\s*Nature of Transaction:\s*(\S+)
  nature_of_supply: (?m)Nature of Supply:\s*(\S+)
  place_of_supply: (?m)^\s*Place of Supply:\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]*?)\s*$
  seller_name: (?m)^\s{2,}(MYNTRA DESIGNS PVT LTD)\s*$
  seller_address: (?m)^MYNTRA DESIGNS PVT LTD,\s*(SY no 8 to 14[\s\S]*?Karnataka-560103)
  seller_tax_id: (?m)GSTIN Number:\s*(\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][0-9A-Z]{3})
  buyer_name: '(?m)^([A-Z][A-Za-z]*(?: [A-Za-z]+)*)\s{2,}SY no 8 to 14'
  amount_gross: (?m)^\s*TOTAL\s+Rs\s+([\d,.]+)
  amount_discount: (?m)^\s*TOTAL\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+\s{2,}Rs\s+([\d,.]+)
  amount_untaxed: (?m)^\s*TOTAL(?:\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+){3}\s+Rs\s+([\d,.]+)
  amount_igst: (?m)^\s*TOTAL(?:\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+){4}\s+Rs\s+([\d,.]+)\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+\s*$
  amount_cgst: (?m)^\s*TOTAL(?:\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+){4}\s+Rs\s+([\d,.]+)\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+\s*$
  amount_sgst: (?m)^\s*TOTAL(?:\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+){5}\s+Rs\s+([\d,.]+)\s+Rs\s+[\d,.]+\s*$
  amount: (?m)^\s*TOTAL.*\sRs\s+([\d,.]+)\s*$
  lines:
    parser: table
    start: (?m)^\s*Other\s{2,}Taxable\s{2,}SGST/
    end: (?m)^\s*TOTAL
    columns:
      qty: Qty
      gross_amount: Gross Amount
      discount: Discount
      amount_other_charges: (?<!\S)(?:Other|Charges)(?!\S)
      price_subtotal: (?<!\S)(?:Taxable|Amount)(?!\S)
      cgst_amount: CGST
      sgst_amount: SGST|UTGST|UGST
      igst_amount: IGST
      cess_amount: Cess
      price_total: Total Amount
    row:
    - price_total
    extra:
    - HSN:\s*(?P<hsn_sac>\d+),\s*(?P<line_tax_percent>[\d.]+)%\s+(?P<tax_type>[A-Z]+)
    - ^\s*(?P<name>[A-Za-z][^\n]*?)\s*$
    types:
      qty: int
      gross_amount: float
      discount: float
      amount_other_charges: float
      price_subtotal: float
      cgst_amount: float
      sgst_amount: float
      igst_amount: float
      cess_amount: float
      price_total: float
options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: .
  date_formats:
  - '%d %b %Y'
  replace:
  - - \r
    - ''

TEMPLATE FORMAT (YAML; use single quotes around every regular expression)
Shapes: fields, options, checks, new_fields and new_line_fields are MAPPINGS (name: value), never
lists; keywords, exclude_keywords, continuation_keywords, required_fields and optional_fields are
LISTS of texts.
issuer: <company that issues the document>
keywords: [2 to 4 texts printed on EVERY document of this layout and on no other issuer's
           documents: the issuer's name, its fixed headings. NEVER a value that changes per
           document (customer name or address, numbers, dates, amounts). Each keyword is copied
           exactly from the text and lies inside one column: never across a gap of 2+ spaces.]
exclude_keywords: [optional: texts that appear only on a look-alike layout]
continuation_keywords: [texts printed on EVERY following page of the document that carries no
                        document number (GST details, terms, instructions, annexures); such a
                        page is attached to the document only when all of these are on it.
                        Needed whenever the document has more than one page.]
required_fields: [issuer, document_type, invoice_number, date, amount, seller_name, ...]
optional_fields: [fields printed on some documents of this layout only]
fields:
  document_type: {parser: static, value: tax_invoice}     # tax_invoice, credit_note, receipt, ...
  invoice_number: 'Invoice No\.\s*:\s*(\S+)'             # exactly ONE capture group
  date: 'Invoice Date\s*:\s*(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})'
  seller_address: {parser: regex, regex: '(?s)Sold By\s*\n(.*?)\nGSTIN', replace: [['\s+', ' ']]}
  tax_rate: {parser: regex, regex: '([\d.]+)%\s+IGST', type: float}
  amount: 'Grand Total\s+(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?)'
  lines:                                                  # the item table
    parser: lines
    start: 'Description\s+Qty\s+Amount'                   # a regex on the header line
    end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                                  # a regex on the line after the table
    first_line: '^\s*(?P<name>\S.*?)\s{2,}(?P<qty>\d+)\s+(?P<price_total>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$'
    line: '^\s{4,}(?P<name>\S.*?)\s*$'                   # continuation lines of a row (optional)
    skip_line: '^\s*Page \d'                              # optional
    types: {qty: int, price_total: float}
  # PREFERRED for item tables that have a header row: read each value by its column heading.
  # Columns the document does not print are simply missing; a printed column you do not list is
  # not read. List every column a document of this issuer CAN print (IGST, or CGST + SGST/UTGST
  # when the seller is in the buyer's state, CESS, Discount), even if this document lacks some.
  # lines:
  #   parser: table
  #   start: '(?m)^\s*Description\s+Qty'          # a regex on the first header line
  #   end: '(?m)^\s*Total'                          # a regex on the line after the table
  #   columns: {name: 'Description', qty: 'Qty', price_unit: 'Rate', price_subtotal: 'Taxable',
  #             igst_amount: 'IGST', cgst_amount: 'CGST', sgst_amount: 'SGST', price_total: 'Total'}
  #   row: [price_total]                             # a row starts on a line with these values
  #   text: after                                    # description lines below the amounts row
  #   extra: ['^\s+HSN:\s*(?P<hsn_sac>\d+)']        # optional patterns for other row lines
  #   types: {qty: int, price_subtotal: float, igst_amount: float, cgst_amount: float, ...}
checks:                                                   # optional, see CHECKS
  disable: [qty x unit price]
  line: [{name: ..., rule: "qty * (price_unit - discount_unit) == price_total", tolerance: "0.01"}]
  document: [{name: ..., rule: "amount_untaxed + amount_cgst + amount_sgst == amount"}]
options:
  currency: INR
  decimal_separator: '.'
  date_formats: ['%d/%m/%Y']                              # REQUIRED when dates are numeric
  replace: [['\r', '']]

TEXT FORM: the text below is what the engine gives every template: pdftotext -layout output,
put in a standard form: "Label :" is written "Label:", trailing spaces removed, shared
indentation removed, at most one blank line in a row. Columns are separated by 2+ spaces.

PATTERN RULES
- Accept small print variations: \s* around colons, \s+ between words, amounts as
  (\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?) so 212.1, 212.10 and 17.582 all match.
- Use (?m) with ^ or $, (?s) when . must cross lines. Never write a pattern that can take a
  value from a different column of the same line: stop at 2+ spaces (\s{2,}) when a right-hand
  column follows.
- Blocks printed side by side (Bill To | Ship To, Sold By | Billing Address): read a block with
  parser: region, which takes the words below a heading inside its column from their positions on
  the page, so the next column cannot run into it:
    buyer_name: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', max_lines: 1}
    buyer_address: {parser: region, heading: 'Bill To', skip: 1, stop: '^Phone'}
  (skip: lines left out at the top; stop: the line that ends the block, not included; join: what
  goes between the lines, default one space, ', ' for an address printed without commas). A
  label with its value on the same line and more lines hanging under the value ("Address: Flat
  12, ..." | "Place of Supply: ..." on the right) is read with same_line: true; the next label

- Pages: the table can continue on the next page with its header printed again; later pages need

- Numbers: 1,499.00 / 1499 / 1,499.0 / 1,23,456.00; minus as -135.00, (135.00) or 135.00-; the
  rupee sign before or after, joined or apart. Amount patterns: (-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,3})?).
- Units: weight in g or kg; quantity as 2 or "2 Nos".
- Optional parts: buyer GSTIN (business purchases only), CIN, FSSAI, state, place of supply are
